attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `yfeC` to `nupC`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 76 to 99% of them, fewest at column 2, `nupC`, 76%.

**A fork at column 3, `hypothetical protein`, is carried by 49%**. A second branch of 5 families runs through columns 31 to 35, in 17 to 28% of chromosomes, all shell. The `yfc` genes, columns 41 to 47, are [[fimbrial proteins]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 78%, and hesitates less there, 0.32 against 0.83 bits. It hesitates most at column 35, `yfdF`, a fork column, 2.10 bits.

**The window ends in variable columns.** Columns 68 to 74, `ubiX` to `rpnB`, are carried by 42 to 59%. The last column is `yfcD`, in 16% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 84% of genes**, 0.65 bits on average, perplexity 2.1 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.79 against 0.25 bits, and names fewer genes, 54% against 95%.

label: yfeC
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yfeC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yfeC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,308 to 1,387 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yfeC once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 84% of genes, 0.65 bits on average (perplexity 2.1 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,213 calls, named 98%, 0.22 bits; shell 11,269 calls, named 59%, 1.39 bits; cloud 1,558 calls, named 11%, 3.56 bits. Outside an RGP 31,834 calls, named 95%, 0.25 bits; inside an RGP 11,206 calls, named 54%, 1.79 bits. Columns: 28 spine, 19 fork, 33 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.79 against 0.25 bits) and names fewer genes (54% against 95%); 11,206 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 35 (yfdF, a fork column) 2.10 bits, RGP 55%; column 34 (mlaA, a fork column) 1.75 bits, RGP 61%; column 36 (fadL, a variable column) 1.72 bits, RGP 47%. The 14 columns (columns 31-35 and 41-49) where most calls are in an RGP: named 69%, 1.26 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 88%, 0.52 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 28 spine columns: named 96%, 0.32 bits on average; the 52 fork and variable columns: named 78%, 0.83 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 35, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: yfeC "YfeC-like transcriptional regulator", pdeA, nupC. named 76-99% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 2 (nupC), named 76%; most hesitant at column 1 (pdeA), 0.63 bits.
[S2] 2. column 3 fork: share 49%, all S, RGP 3%. named 44%; 0.10 bits.

[S3] 3. columns 4-12 (9 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 0-3%. [S4] 4. column 13 variable: share 89%, all P, RGP 0.2%. named 95%; 0.44 bits.

[S5] 5. columns 14-25 (12 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%.
